title: Supreme Court sets June 29 ruling date as Barrett emerges as swing vote on mail ballots
summary: The court scheduled its decision for June 29. Justice Amy Coney Barrett's questioning suggested she may join the liberals, making her the deciding vote on whether 14 states' deadlines survive.

title: California's cheap insulin arrives at pharmacies across the state
summary: The state-made $30 vials reached shelves this week under the CalRx program.

title: Reports: California now selling its own $30 insulin, according to AP
summary: According to the Associated Press, California has become the first state to sell state-made insulin at $30 a vial.
